text:
carmen: Evening shift — I'm off at ~19:00 PT. Quick handoff notes and what to watch:

carmen: • Deploy: canary push for svc-infer succeeded (v3.4.1). Rolling window tomorrow at noon for full rollout.

carmen: • Symptom to watch: intermittent 503s with log marker "traffic-shaper timeout" when worker pool drops below 2. Usually spikes during big batched requests.

carmen: • Prefetch: kicked a prewarm run at 18:10 for common prompt bundles (embed + qa). Cache warming looks good but gpu-proxy CPU climbed to ~70% on a couple pods.

carmen: • Action if you see shaper timeouts: scale gpu-proxy to 3 replicas and check queue drain. Command:
```
kubectl -n redwood-prod scale deploy gpu-proxy --replicas=3
```

carmen: • If scaling doesn't help, revert canary (svc-infer:v3.4.1 -> v3.3.8) and open a rollback ticket. I left the canary tag pinned in the console.

ben: Quick question — how to confirm it's the shaper and not upstream model OOMs? Any log grep you prefer?

carmen: Good call. Look for the shaper marker and OOM lines together. Example quick check: `kubectl logs -l app=gpu-proxy -n redwood-prod --tail=200 | egrep \"shaper|OOM\"` 

ben: perfect, thanks. I can jump in if it flares while you're out.

liam: I'll be on until 21:30 PT, can cover the first 90m. If I see >5% error rate on /v1/generate, I'll scale and annotate in the incident channel.

sam: FYI — model-quantizer rollout is queued behind canary health. I set a manual pause so we don't cascade changes during evening traffic.

oncall-bot: Reminder: rotation switch scheduled — liam takes over at 19:00 PT.

ben: One more: prefetch job sometimes stomps disk on the prefetcher pod. If you see disk pressure alerts, delete the prefetch job and restart the prefetcher pod (it will restart clean).

carmen: noted and added to watchlist: console alert for route=/v1/generate to fire if 99p latency > 1.2s for 5m and error rate > 3% for 1m.

liam: ack, I'll keep an eye on latency + GPU utilization. Ping me in-thread if you scale so I can annotate autoscaler metrics.

sam: Thanks — leaving a short runbook snippet in ops-docs: section "evening-traffic-shaper" with the commands you mentioned.

carmen: Thanks all. If anything spikes after I sign off, ping @liam and @ben. I'm reachable on phone for 30m if needed. :wave:

liam: :eyes: got it.

ben: :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Note: no active incidents. Scheduled checks at 19:10 and 19:40.
